status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: Coin Metrics files are on disk (ADR 0099); their column volume_reported_spot_usd_1d (all 473 files) has never been read into a signal. CapMrktEstUSD was used only as supply growth and turnover/mcap (0099). Rounds 1-6 (ADR 0096-0101) known, all NOT_PROMISING.
requested_by: 동동, 2026-11-20 '기준을 통과하는 전략이 나올때까지 계속 돌려 멈추지 말고'. Round 7 of that loop.

already_tested_not_repeated: Binance spot vs perp volume (0096 V1/V2)
size via perp quote volume (0040 N1)
new_here: all-exchange reported spot volume (Coin Metrics) vs Binance perp volume: where trading happens outside Binance perps
size by estimated market capitalisation (not by volume)
market-cap rank minus volume rank (attention relative to size)

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0096-0101 U50 (cut-off bar i-2); Coin Metrics asset mapping as ADR 0099; rows outside DEV segments never read

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding

quintile_rule: names of the universe with a signal; K = floor(n_with_signal / 5); need n_with_signal >= 10; equal weight 1/(2K) (as ADR 0099)

trials.XS1_SPOTSHARE_LEVEL_U50: ln(sum volume_reported_spot_usd_1d cut-27..cut / sum Binance perp quote volume cut-27..cut) (>= 20 days both > 0); long the HIGHEST (spot-led demand across venues)
trials.XS2_SPOTSHARE_CHANGE_U50: mean daily ln ratio over cut-6..cut minus over cut-34..cut-7 (>= 5 / >= 20 days); long the HIGHEST
trials.SZ1_MCAP_SIZE_U50: ln(mean CapMrktEstUSD cut-6..cut) (>= 5 days); long the LOWEST (small caps)
trials.AT1_ATTENTION_U50: rank of 30-day mean perp quote volume (1 = largest) minus rank of mean CapMrktEstUSD cut-6..cut, within names with both; long the LOWEST (traded little relative to size)

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost 'cal' decides; cal_x2, cal_tail_x2 conditions; cost0 reference
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0101; DSR N=4 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 4 S1 series reported
known_limits_written_before_results: Coin Metrics community history may be revised (not point-in-time); reported spot volume includes venues with inflated volume.
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +4 regardless.
